title: Review an uncommitted change in `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal` that lets agents with spawned subagents be folded/opened i…
summary: I found no correctness bugs in the fold logic itself. There are four behaviour problems worth fixing, plus some test gaps. All the fold tests pass. `cargo test -p aura-ui-terminal` gave 652 passed and 18 failed, and every failure is a test setup step hitting "Disk quota exceeded" (os error 122) on this machine, not a fold-related failure.
